hypotheses.R0_top_channels_are_factor_asymmetric: At least half of selected channels have one cross term supplying at least 80% of absolute cross-term magnitude in every cell.
hypotheses.R1_balanced_channels_are_a_minority: At most 30% of selected channels have dominance at or below 60% in every cell.
hypotheses.R2_recurring_channels_keep_their_factor_: Median dominant-side agreement among channels selected in at least five examples is at least 0.75 in every cell.
hypotheses.R3_channel_identity_is_contextual: Median cross-corpus top-256 Jaccard for the same lexical pair is at most 0.25 in both layers.
hypotheses.R4_factor_role_transfers_when_identity_r: Median dominant-side agreement on cross-corpus channel intersections is at least 0.75 in both layers.
hypotheses.R5_contribution_sign_transfers_when_iden: Median contribution-sign agreement on cross-corpus channel intersections is at least 0.65 in both layers.
hypotheses.R6_quadratic_term_is_negligible_per_chan: Median quadratic share among selected channels is below 0.05 in every cell.
